blocks.raw: > Akamai's Alerts application is a monitoring tool that both analyzes historical audience metrics and projects the expected traffic. Using intelligent algorithms, this service compares projected traffic with actual traffic in real time, and includes static alerts based on thresholds you set. It can trigger adaptive web alerts when current audience metrics goes above or below projected traffic. It does this by taking into consideration accurate traffic patterns modeled on historical data rather than on static thresholds.

It does this by taking into consideration accurate traffic patterns modeled on historical data rather than on static thresholds.
